rules.subject: gameplay
notes: [Utilizing brush] The visual indicators and effects of some abilities, such as Absolute Zero Nunu and Decimating Smash Sion, are hidden while inside of an unexposed brush.
[Utilizing brush] Moving into a brush while fleeing from chasing enemies allows the manipulation of the fog of war.
[Utilizing brush] Ivern is currently the only champion who can create brush, being able to do so via Ivern. He can create a line of brushes, blocking the sight of the enemy in any location.
notesKo: [덤불] 누누 R 절대 영도나 사이온 Q 파멸의 강타처럼 일부 스킬의 시전 표시는 드러나지 않은 덤불 안에서는 보이지 않습니다.
[덤불] 쫓기는 중에 덤불로 들어가면 상대의 시야를 흔들 수 있습니다.
[덤불] 아이번은 덤불을 만들 수 있는 유일한 챔피언입니다. 덤불을 줄지어 만들어 어느 곳에서든 적 시야를 끊을 수 있습니다.
notesZh: [利用草丛] 部分技能的视觉指示和效果（例如努努的绝对零度和赛恩的残虐猛击）在未被敌方视野照亮的草丛中会隐藏。
[利用草丛] 逃离追击的敌人时进入草丛，可以利用战争迷雾。
[利用草丛] 艾翁是目前唯一能够创造草丛的英雄，可以通过艾翁做到这一点。他能创造一排草丛，在任何位置阻挡敌方视野。

rules.name: 포탑
rules.subject: gameplay
notes: [General] Plates take 17% reduced damage from minions and ranged champions.
[General] Destroying a plate grants 125 local gold.
[General] The toplane and midlane outer turrets receive a Fortification bonus for the first five minutes of each game.
[General] Inhibitor turrets regenerate 3 health per second up to a maximum that depends on their current health.
[General] Nexus turrets regenerate 6 health per second up to a maximum that depends on their current health.
[General] After being destroyed Nexus Turrets will respawn after a 3 minute delay.
[General] Armor and magic resistance are reduced to 40 at 12:00.
[General] Inhibitor turrets gain 30% damage reduction for 60 seconds after the Outer Turret is destroyed.
[Notes] If a turret is destroyed while one of its shots is in mid-flight, that shot will not deal damage.
[Notes] Turrets are units located on top of impassable terrain. This terrain remains even after the turret is destroyed.
[Notes] Effects that interact with terrain will do so for both functional and destroyed turrets.
[Items] Unique Passive - Fortification: 85% damage reduction from all sources. This effect expires after 5 minutes.
[Items] Unique Passive: Gains 30% armor penetration.

[Items] Unique Passive - Dodge Piercing: Turret attacks, once their windup has completed, cannot be evaded, parried, nor intercepted. They will be still be destroyed by effects that 'pop' homing projectiles, such as their target becoming untargetable.

[Items] Unique Passive - Warming Up: The damage dealt by turrets increases by 40% each time they hit a champion, up to 120% bonus damage. This effect resets 3 seconds after the last shot hits a champion, but it doesn't reset when switching targets.
[Items] Unique Passive - Reinforced Armor: Reduces incoming damage by 80%, including true damage, when no enemy minions or Summoned Rift Herald are nearby.
[Items] Pets, traps, and neutral monsters do not deactivate this effect.
[Items] Unique Passive - True Sight: Can see all units and traps (including those in stealth) within 1000 range, unless the direct line of vision is obstructed (e.g. by terrain).
[Turret rewards] The global reward is given to all the champions in the team.

[Turret rewards] Champions who are alive and have assisted in destroying the turret by dealing damage to it directly or via their summons (including the Rift Herald Mercenary) within the last 10 seconds receive their share as well, regardless of range.
[Turret rewards] The paradigm for local rewards also apply to the distributed reward from destroying Turret Plating stages.
[Turret rewards] The local reward for destroying the first turret (also referred to as "Turret First Blood" and "First Turret gold") grants 300 bonus gold.
[Damaging turrets] Physical damage if 100% bonus AD > 60% AP.
[Damaging turrets] Magic damage if 100% bonus AD < 60% AP.
[Abilities that affect turrets] Turrets can be put into stasis by Tempered Fate Bard.
[Abilities that affect turrets] Turrets can be shielded by Eye of the Storm Janna.
[Abilities that affect turrets] Turrets can be disabled by Stormbringer Volibear.
[Abilities that affect turrets] Carnivore Cho'Gath grants its heal and mana restore.
[Abilities that affect turrets] League of Draven Draven grants 1 stack.
[Abilities that affect turrets] Siphoning Strike Nasus gains permanent damage.
[Abilities that affect turrets] Loaded Dice Twisted Fate grants him 1 to 6.

[Strategy] Turrets can be used to create choke points using traps such as Yordle Snap Trap Caitlyn, especially in the narrow areas between a turret and nearby terrain, as minions will not normally walk through those areas of lanes.
[Strategy] Melee minions may sustain two turret attacks, and then one champion attack to last hit.
[Strategy] Ranged minions may sustain one champion attack, then one turret attack, then another champion attack to last hit.
notesKo: [포탑] 방패 장치는 미니언과 원거리 챔피언에게 받는 피해가 17% 줄어듭니다.
[포탑] 방패 장치를 하나 깨면 그 자리에 있던 아군에게 125골드가 들어갑니다.
[포탑] 탑과 미드의 1차 포탑은 경기 시작 후 5분간 요새화 보너스를 받습니다.
[포탑] 억제기 포탑은 초당 체력 3을 회복하며, 회복 상한은 현재 체력에 따라 달라집니다.

rules.name: 시야 점수
rules.subject: gameplay
notes: [Metrics] Vision Mechanics: There are a few non-combat utility abilities that will contribute to a champion's total vision score.

[Metrics] These include Scryer's Bloom and Rift Scuttler's Speed Shrine. The former grants a total of 0.5 points per champion revealed by the effect, and the latter grants 1 point once it has lasted its full duration.

[Metrics] Champion abilities that only grant vision (no offensive component) will contribute towards the score. Examples include Hawkshot Ashe, Sentinel Kalista, and Heightened Senses Quinn. These abilities will grant 0.33 points per champion they reveal.

[Ward Lifetime Provided Modifiers] A ward that hasn't seen any interesting units (enemy champions, wards, and epic monsters) in a while will gradually go down in point value, starting at -0% at 60 seconds of staleness and worsening to -50% at 120 seconds of staleness.

[Ward Lifetime Provided Modifiers] While a ward is near other allied sources of vision (allied wards, structures, and lane minions), its point value will be reduced, starting at -25% for 1 redundancy and worsening up to -75% for 3+ redundancies. Lane minions don't count as redundant if the ward is in brush.
[Ward Lifetime Provided Modifiers] A ward that's very close to your base can give less score, starting from -0% score around your buff camps and worsening to about -50% score at your base walls.
[Ward Lifetime Provided Modifiers] A ward that's very close to an allied structure or inside your own base will have a -100% modifier to its point value.
[Ward Lifetime Provided Modifiers] If a ward is quickly killed by enemies, it will still give lifetime score as if it survived a minimum of 20 seconds (0.33 points).
notesKo: [시야 점수] 전투와 무관한 일부 유틸 스킬도 시야 점수에 들어갑니다.
[시야 점수] 예언의 꽃과 협곡 바위게의 가속 성소가 그렇습니다. 앞의 것은 드러낸 챔피언 한 명당 0.5점, 뒤의 것은 지속시간을 다 채우면 1점을 줍니다.
[시야 점수] 공격 성분 없이 시야만 주는 스킬도 점수에 들어갑니다. 애쉬 E 매 눈, 칼리스타 W 파수병, 퀸 W 예리한 감각이 그렇고, 드러낸 챔피언 한 명당 0.33점입니다.
[시야 점수] 한동안 적 챔피언·와드·대형 몬스터를 보지 못한 와드는 점수 가치가 떨어집니다. 60초째에는 감점이 없고 120초째에 -50%까지 떨어집니다.
[시야 점수] 아군 와드·구조물·라인 미니언처럼 다른 아군 시야와 겹치면 점수가 깎입니다. 하나 겹치면 -25%, 셋 이상 겹치면 -75%입니다. 와드가 덤불 안에 있으면 라인 미니언은 겹침으로 세지 않습니다.
[시야 점수] 본진에 가까운 와드일수록 점수가 낮습니다. 아군 버프 캠프 근처에서는 감점이 없고 본진 성벽에서는 약 -50%입니다.
[시야 점수] 아군 구조물에 아주 가깝거나 본진 안에 있는 와드는 점수가 -100%가 됩니다.
[시야 점수] 적이 와드를 금방 부숴도 최소 20초는 살아 있던 것으로 쳐서 0.33점을 줍니다.
notesZh: [数据指标] 视野机制：少数非战斗类功能技能会计入英雄的总视野得分。
[数据指标] 其中包括占卜花朵和峡谷迅捷蟹的加速圣坛。前者每揭示一名英雄可提供总计0.5点，后者在持续时间结束后提供1点。
[数据指标] 仅提供视野（没有进攻效果）的英雄技能会计入视野得分。例如艾希的鹰击长空、卡莉丝塔的哨兵和奎因的敏锐感知。每揭示一名英雄，这些技能可提供0.33点。
[守卫存续时间修正] 守卫若有一段时间没有侦测到有价值的单位（敌方英雄、守卫和史诗级野怪），其分值会逐渐降低：闲置60秒时修正为-0%，闲置120秒时降至-50%。
[守卫存续时间修正] 守卫靠近其他友方视野来源（友方守卫、建筑和线上小兵）时，分值会降低：存在1处视野重叠时修正为-25%，存在3处或更多时最高降至-75%。如果守卫位于草丛中，线上小兵不计为视野重叠。
[守卫存续时间修正] 守卫离己方基地非常近时，获得的视野得分可能会降低：在己方增益野怪营地附近约为-0%，到基地墙边则降至约-50%。
[守卫存续时间修正] 守卫非常靠近友方建筑或位于己方基地内时，其分值修正为-100%。
[守卫存续时间修正] 如果守卫很快被敌人摧毁，仍会按至少存续20秒计算存续时间得分（0.33点）。

rules.name: 귀환
rules.subject: gameplay
notes: [Notes] Recall is activated by either clicking on its icon in the HUD or by pressing the selected key bind (B is set to the default).
[Notes] Recall's channel is interrupted by ground and root.
[Notes] Recall's channel is not interrupted by taking damage in the final 0.1 seconds before it completes.
[Notes] Damage fully mitigated by a shield won't cancel Recall.
[Notes] Death's Dance Ignore Pain damage does not interrupt Recall.

[Notes] Recall is not visible through the fog of war, but if a Recalling champion was seen Recalling before being obscured from sight, the sound effects can still be heard, but this does not necessarily mean the channel was completed.
[Notes] When a player disconnects from the game, instead of Recalling, they will manually walk back to their base. After some time, their champion will become completely invincible.
notesKo: [귀환] 귀환은 화면의 아이콘을 누르거나 지정한 단축키(기본 B)로 씁니다.
[귀환] 귀환 시전은 속박과 정지 효과에 끊깁니다.
[귀환] 귀환이 끝나기 직전 0.1초 안에 받은 피해로는 시전이 끊기지 않습니다.
[귀환] 보호막이 전부 막아 낸 피해로는 귀환이 취소되지 않습니다.
[귀환] 죽음의 무도가 미뤄 두는 피해로는 귀환이 끊기지 않습니다.
[귀환] 전장의 안개 너머의 귀환은 보이지 않습니다. 다만 귀환을 시작하는 것을 본 뒤 시야에서 사라졌다면 소리는 계속 들리는데, 그렇다고 귀환이 끝났다는 뜻은 아닙니다.
[귀환] 접속이 끊긴 플레이어는 귀환 대신 걸어서 본진으로 돌아갑니다. 일정 시간이 지나면 그 챔피언은 완전히 무적이 됩니다.
notesZh: [说明] 可通过点击HUD上的回城图标或按下所选按键来启动回城（默认按键为B）。
[说明] 受到地面效果或禁锢效果会打断回城引导。
[说明] 回城完成前最后0.1秒内受到伤害不会打断回城引导。
[说明] 被护盾完全抵消的伤害不会打断回城。
[说明] 死亡之舞的忽视痛苦伤害不会打断回城。
[说明] 回城不会在战争迷雾中显示；但如果回城中的英雄在被遮蔽前已被看见，仍可能听到回城音效，但这不一定表示回城引导已经完成。
[说明] 玩家断开游戏连接时，英雄不会回城，而是会自行走回基地。一段时间后，该英雄会完全免疫伤害。
